title: The two tower Chern components of the diagonal divisor
statement:
theorem diagonalTrace_divisorChernAdjoint_components
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (hS : IsUnit (l : Γ(ProjectiveLine Y, ⊤)))
    (hX : IsUnit (l : Γ(diagonalSurface Y, ⊤)))
    (f : diagonalSurface Y ⟶ ProjectiveLine Y)
    (hf : f = pullback.fst (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) ∨
      f = pullback.snd (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y))
    (p : Presentation l E f) :
    ∃ β : unit (ProjectiveLine Y) (Arings l E (ProjectiveLine Y)) ⟶
        (line l E p.chernS)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧,
      (SpTowerShriek.adjunction l E p.base p.model.geometry).homEquiv _ _
          ((p.model.coefficientPullback.derivedIso l E).hom ≫
            firstChern l E p.chernX (diagonalPic Y)) =
        β ≫ p.model.twistedUnit l E + p.model.chernAdjoint l E

proof.text: Factor diagonalPic as the pullback of an invertible base module times the hyperplane class of p.model.

Use tower_lineBundleClass_mul for additivity of the actual integral constant-system line class. The reduction and scalar functors are additive by their adjunctions, and endpoint composition distributes over sums. This proves firstChernR_mul and firstChern_mul without expanding the line-class comparison in this module.

Apply tower_firstChern_pullback to the base line, with p.normalizedS, p.normalizedX and the model coefficient and line pullback comparisons. This identifies the base summand with pullback of its base Chern morphism followed by the shifted line comparison.
Take adjuncts of the sum. The hom equivalence is additive; naturality in its source identifies the base summand with beta followed by twistedUnit. The other adjunct is chernAdjoint by definition.
